title: Why is my Oracle query slow? A step-by-step SQL tuning guide (40 min → 2 sec)
desc:
A monthly report ran in 2 seconds on Friday and 40 minutes on Monday. Nobody changed the code 😱
In this video we fix it step by step, the way you would in production: no guessing, no random hints.

🔍 Get the REAL plan: GATHER_PLAN_STATISTICS + DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_CURSOR 'ALLSTATS LAST', or SQL Monitor
🌳 Read the plan as a tree: the most indented line runs first, rows flow up
🎯 Find the first line, from the bottom, where E-Rows and A-Rows differ by orders of magnitude
📊 Stale statistics after a big load → DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS, histograms on skewed columns
🎭 Bind peeking: the first value decides the plan for everyone, and adaptive cursor sharing
🚫 Index ignored? Functions on the column and implicit conversions hide it
🛠️ Fix in the right order: SQL → statistics → index → baseline / SQL patch → hint last
✅ Verify with real numbers, then lock the good plan with a SQL plan baseline

Result: 40 minutes → 2.1 seconds, 9.8M buffers → 85K 💡
